title: Ben Met a Bug
lines: Ben got a bug in a net.
Ben set the bug in a tin.
The bug did not beg. It did not sit.
It got up. It got on the bed!
Dad met the bug on the bed.
The bug is not a pet. It can go.
Ben is sad. But Ben can get a pup.

questions.ask: Where did Ben put the bug at first?
questions.listenFor: In a tin. The story says it. If your child is stuck, help them find the word tin and read that line again.

questions.ask: Why did the bug end up going free?
questions.listenFor: It would not stay put - it climbed out and got on the bed. Listen for the bug not acting like a pet.

questions.ask: Do you think a bug makes a good pet? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. You are listening for a reason, and a reason pulled from the story is best of all.
